authority_and_preservation.authorization: User approval with amendments in active conversation
authority_and_preservation.future_emulation_instruction: The re-commissioned emulation session should relocate the five listed paths into its own worktree before continuing. This T-05 operation does not move or edit them.
authority_and_preservation.stratum_A: Commit campaign records from a clean worktree at merged base 4edcd02; includes three byte-identical receipt mirrors with originals retained.
authority_and_preservation.stratum_B: No current dirty primary paths overlap the compose slice. Existing 7c0edbad compose commit and boundary worktree remain deferred to L-04 with correspondence receipt.
authority_and_preservation.stratum_C: Preserve all listed paths exactly as-is, including deletions and the five ecosystem-emulation session paths; do not commit them.

delta_from_G3_merge_receipt.explanation: Founder-confirmed early writes from the ecosystem-emulation session in the shared tree before its own-worktree condition was set; its context later crashed. These five remain Stratum C and are not committed by T-05.

hash_proof.algorithm: SHA-256 over exact git status --porcelain=v1 -z bytes
hash_proof.operation: Remove only the five listed status records from current porcelain bytes; retain all other records and NUL delimiters in original order.

directory_hash_note: For status rows whose path is an untracked directory, sha256 is computed over canonical JSON for all recursive descendants, sorted by path; each member binds relative path, kind, mode, and file-byte or symlink-target SHA-256. Directory rows are collapsed by the declared normal porcelain mode. Deleted files bind the HEAD blob SHA-256 with kind=missing.
